fields.name: email
fields.description: Lowercased email; UNIQUE — dedup key across all sources

fields.name: first_name
fields.description: First name; pick most-recent non-null across sources

fields.name: last_name
fields.description: Last name; pick most-recent non-null across sources

fields.name: company_name
fields.description: Company; pick from Marketo or CSV (Mailchimp doesn't have it)

fields.name: first_seen_at
fields.description: Earliest known timestamp across all sources (MIN)

fields.name: lead_score
fields.description: Marketo lead score; null if contact only exists in Mailchimp/CSV

fields.name: all_sources
fields.description: Comma-separated list of source names contributing to this contact

fields.name: tag_list
fields.description: Mailchimp tags; concat of all tag values found
